main_text.p: נְכֹחָה recta, נְכֹחִים recti, f.f. & pl. m. No. f. m.
נִכְחוֹ è regione ejus, f. m. aff. qu. No. נָכְחָה; & נְכֹחוֹ rectitudo sua, f. m. aff. No. נָכְחָה, à No. Rad. נכח[?].
וְנַכְחִידֵם & excindemus eos, fut. Hiph. 1 pl. aff. Rad. כָּחַד[?].
וְנִכְחָתָה & redarguta, sing. fæm. Part. Niph. aliàs est, נְכָחָה, à praet. Niph. נָכַח; Rad. יָכַח[?].
נִכְלוּ machinati sunt, praet. Piel, 3. pl. R. נָכַל.
נִכְלָם erubuit, נִכְלְמוּ erubuerunt, praet. Niph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. כָּלַם.
וְנַכֵּם & percutiemus eos, נַכֵּנוּ eum, fut. Hiph. 1.
נְכֹנִים aptati, Part. Niph. pl. m. à f. m. נָכֹן; Rad. כּוּן.
נִכְסוֹף desiderio affici, Gen. 31.30. pro הַכְּסֵף, Infin. Niph. Rad. כָּסַף.
נְכָסִים opes, No. pl. m. R. inusit. נָכַם.
נִכְסְפָה desiderio tenebatur, praet. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. כָּסַף.
נִכְסָתָה operitur, praet. Niph. 3. sing. fæm. à 3. f. m. נִכְסָה; Rad. כָּסָה.
וְנִכְפַּר & expiabitur, Deut. 21.8. est comp. ex praet Niph. & praet. Hithp Rad. כָּפַר.
נִכַּר agnitus fuit, נִכְּרוּ agniti fuere, praet. Niph. vel Piel; 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. נָכַר.
נָכְרִי extraneus, נָכְרִים extranei, נָכְרִיָּה alienigena, נָכְרִיּוֹת alienigenae,

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek letters are transcribed from a low-resolution scan, so vowel points and some consonants are uncertain and marked [?] where doubtful. The running head letters are also uncertain. The alienigenae line runs on at the foot of the right column and is cut short by the catchword "ne,". The signature "Pp 3" and catchword "ne," are placed at the foot of the right column.
